name: Dev Labtech Venture Limited
summary: Dev Labtech Venture Limited specializes in the creation, global distribution, and acquisition of both natural and laboratory-grown diamonds. Its production processes cover the entire journey, from refining rough natural stones into polished gems, to cultivating lab-grown diamonds from their initial seed form to their perfected state. These diamonds are presented in a wide array of sizes, shapes, clarity levels, and colors. The company commenced operations on April 29, 1993, and maintains its primary office in Bhavnagar, India.
